Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour

08:00 – Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, or homestay and transfer you to our bicycle office, where you can choose the most suitable bike and receive a safety briefing. If your hotel is conveniently located, we can also bring the bicycles directly to your hotel.

After getting ready, we will start cycling from your hotel and head out for our countryside ride.

Crossing Long Bien Bridge

Our first highlight is crossing the Red River via Long Bien Bridge – the oldest bridge in Hanoi, built over 100 years ago during the French colonial period. From here, you can enjoy beautiful views of the Red River, watch boats passing underneath, and see the lush green vegetable farms on the river island.

Countryside and Local Life

We then cycle into the countryside, where local farmers live and work. Here, you will have the chance to visit a local family, learn more about daily life and traditions, and have meaningful conversations with them. Our guide will assist to make the interaction easy and insightful.

Co Loa Ancient Citadel

We continue cycling along dirt roads and through rural villages to reach Co Loa Ancient Citadel, originally built in 275 BC. Here, you will learn about Vietnam’s long tradition of establishing and defending the country, as well as the history of King Thuc Phan An Duong Vuong and his struggle against foreign invaders.

Fruit Garden – Lunch – Egg Coffee

After visiting Co Loa, we will stop at a fruit garden, where you can see how local fruits are grown. Then we cycle back to Hanoi for lunch at a local restaurant, where you will enjoy traditional Vietnamese dishes.

We finish the trip in the Old Quarter with a cup of egg coffee, a famous local specialty, before transferring you back to your hotel.

Tour Includes

  • Professional English–speaking guide

  • Quality mountain bike

  • All entry fees and free bottled water during the tour

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Pick up and drop off

  • Helmet
